issuing_authority: Prosus N.V. (policy reviewed by the Risk Committee of the Board of Directors)
geo_constraints: Prosus N.V. and all Prosus Group Companies (subsidiaries); principles also considered in investments and partnerships

locale_context.regulation: Self-regulation · group-level principles-based policy for portfolio companies
locale_context.culture: Holding-company governance of a global technology portfolio: principles set at group level, implementation delegated to each business and CEO, adapted to local cultures and law, with board Risk Committee oversight.

versions.title: Last reviewed and approved on 27 November 2024
versions.summary: Only one version recorded for this policy.
versions.note: 'Last reviewed and approved' implies earlier versions; original issue date not stated.

covered_systems: AI systems and models developed, used or deployed by Group companies
covered_activities: employee use of company AI tools
conditions: Each business implements the policy adapted to its business model, size, maturity, local cultures, compliance obligations and resources
objective: Make ethical considerations an integral part of AI development across the Prosus Group and ensure investments go to companies applying globally benchmarked responsible AI standards.
conflict_rule: Where specific AI laws (including the EU AI Act) apply, Group companies must ensure their requirements are met.

record_provenance.notes: Text taken from the copy in asago-ai/asago-policy-mapper (policy_examples/prosus.pdf). The document states only 'Last reviewed and approved on 27 November 2024'; original issue date, version number and effective date are not given (effective_date left null). The Risk Committee reviews the policy annually, so a newer review may exist. Status 'enforceable' as an approved group policy that 'directly appl[ies] to all Prosus Group Companies', though much of its language is aspirational ('expected', 'strive'); binding=false (corporate policy, not law). The policy text refers to Group support in 'Section 7', but the document has only six sections. Extraction was clean.

clauses.section: 3. Responsible AI Guiding Principles – Fairness and inclusivity
clauses.original_text: We strive to avoid creating unfair biases and reinforcing or exacerbating existing biases. We ensure that fairness and inclusivity considerations are appropriately incorporated in the development and deployment of AI systems.
clauses.object: AI systems under development and deployment
clauses.requirement: avoid creating or reinforcing unfair bias
clauses.interpretation_notes: Verbatim from the asago copy (prosus.pdf); line breaks collapsed. 'Strive' (first sentence) is aspirational; 'ensure' (second) is firmer.

clauses.section: 3. Responsible AI Guiding Principles – Accountability & transparency
clauses.original_text: The designers of systems have an ongoing duty to appropriately document how they implement these principles, and to monitor and control for performance over time. Furthermore, AI systems and their outputs should be context-sensitive, transparent and explainable to different stakeholders in appropriate circumstances. Where possible, we disclose relevant information regarding the use of AI in non-technical terms to foster trust from individuals and businesses alike.
clauses.actor: designers of AI systems; Prosus Group
clauses.action: document, monitor performance, disclose AI use
clauses.requirement: document principle implementation, monitor performance, disclose AI use where possible
clauses.interpretation_notes: Verbatim from the asago copy (prosus.pdf); line breaks collapsed. 'Ongoing duty' is mandatory; explainability and disclosure are qualified (SHOULD-level).

clauses.section: 3. Responsible AI Guiding Principles – Privacy & security
clauses.original_text: Data used to train and deploy AI systems must be proportionate, handled in conformity with applicable data protection laws. We make sure that the AI we develop, use and deploy are designed in a way that minimises known security threats, through appropriate technical and organisational measures.
clauses.action: handle data proportionately; minimise security threats
clauses.object: training and deployment data; AI systems
clauses.requirement: proportionate, lawful data use and security-by-design
clauses.purpose: protect personal data and system security
clauses.applicable_systems: AI developed, used or deployed by the Group
clauses.interpretation_notes: Verbatim from the asago copy (prosus.pdf); line breaks collapsed.

clauses.original_text: Should investee companies operate in jurisdictions where specific AI laws apply, including but not limited to the European Union Artificial Intelligence Act (EU AI Act), they must ensure that the requirements of such laws are met.
clauses.object: requirements of applicable AI laws, including the EU AI Act
clauses.condition: where specific AI laws apply in the company's jurisdiction
clauses.applicable_systems: AI systems subject to specific AI laws
clauses.interpretation_notes: Verbatim from the asago copy (prosus.pdf); line breaks collapsed. Same section expects Group companies to publish their own responsible AI governance principles.

clauses.original_text: Our Group companies are expected to appropriately design for privacy, security, transparency, bias controls, and robustness as an integral part of development and deployment of AI systems and models.
clauses.object: privacy, security, transparency, bias controls and robustness
clauses.requirement: build privacy, security, transparency, bias controls and robustness into AI systems
clauses.applicable_systems: AI systems and models developed and deployed by Group companies
clauses.interpretation_notes: Verbatim from the asago copy (prosus.pdf); line breaks collapsed.

clauses.original_text: Group companies are to implement appropriate processes aimed at auditing for accountability, bias and risks implicated by specific AI models. This can be enabled through adopting tools for bias check as part of model-development practices.
clauses.object: accountability, bias and risks of AI models
clauses.requirement: audit AI models for bias and risk, e.g. with bias-check tools
clauses.interpretation_notes: Verbatim from the asago copy (prosus.pdf); line breaks collapsed.
